text: Staging deploys run every weekday at 16:00 UTC from the main branch. The deploy bot needs the staging environment variables before it starts. Roll back with the rollback script if error rates pass 2% within ten minutes of a deploy.

New engineers get VPN access through the identity portal. Approval comes from their manager, then the VPN profile is provisioned automatically. Profiles expire after 90 days and must be renewed. Do not share profiles between laptops.

Run migrations against the staging database first, then production during the maintenance window. The migration service account is limited to schema changes only. Take a snapshot before any migration that alters the users table. Connection details live in the secrets vault, never in this doc.

For SEV2 incidents, page the on-call engineer and open the incident channel. The on-call rotation is listed in the paging tool. Escalate to SEV1 if customer-facing error rates stay above 5% for fifteen minutes. Post the timeline to the status page once the incident is contained.

The nightly billing export pulls usage rows from the warehouse and writes them to the finance bucket. The export job uses a read-only warehouse role. Finance decrypts the files with their own key on their side. Never email the export files.

Friday handoff: the staging deploy bot was flaky this week, keep an eye on the 16:00 run. The paging tool webhook for alerts was reconfigured on Thursday. If the webhook stops delivering, check the alerting config before paging the platform team.
Logs are kept for 90 days, then deleted. Backups are kept for 30 days. Customer data exports require a ticket and manager approval. Anonymized analytics data has no retention limit.

Before enabling a vendor integration: verify the vendor's SOC 2 report, scope the integration to read-only where possible, and add the vendor to the quarterly access review. OAuth app credentials are issued per integration and rotated yearly.
